The alate is not described (Imago: Unbekannt); the original also notes "Arbeiter ähnliche Formen liegen vor" (worker-like forms are present). OCR problems: the measurement table was split by OCR into a single column of numbers, German decimal commas and points are mixed, and only "3—3.57" could be read in the head length (without mandibles) column; the number of antennal segments was printed as "13—15 gliedrig".

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellow, mandibles dark brown; body straw yellow. Head covered with long and short setae, the abdominal tergites with two rows of rather indistinct setae. Head thick, quadrate—oval, distinctly narrowed anteriorly; frons flat, very weakly concave in the middle; antennal carinae slightly overhanging the antennal fossae. Compound eyes minute. Clypeobasale short. Labrum quadrate, its length distinctly less than its width. Mandibles rather long and stout; first marginal tooth of the left mandible larger than the teeth behind it, the two triangular and directed forwards; third and fourth marginal teeth elongate and T-shaped, the fourth much longer than the third. Antennae 13—15-segmented, segment 3 longer than segment 2, segment 4 distinctly shorter than segment 2. Pronotum slightly narrower than the head, its length slightly less than half its width; anterior margin weakly concave, the anterior angles almost right-angled and rounded, the posterior angles more rounded, the posterior margin very slightly concave. Meso- and metanota narrower than the pronotum. Measurements: body length 9—10 mm; head length (with mandibles) 4.71—5.47 mm; head length (without mandibles) 3—3.57 mm; head width 2.43—2.85 mm; pronotum length 0.91—1.10 mm; pronotum width 2.09—2.36 mm. The peculiar head shape makes the soldier resemble the genus Termes.
